metadata.description: All 298 curated events and phases in one timeline, 1957–2025. Use Type, Track and Time range to focus on a theme, mission or period without switching graphs.

edgeSemantics.sequence: Recorded chronological order only. Does not assert a causal or technical dependency; selected-milestone links may skip intervening events.
edgeSemantics.part-of: Source contains the target milestone or hosted flight. Interval endpoints describe the named phase, not necessarily a whole mission.
edgeSemantics.dependency: A dated boundary starts or completes the named Apollo 11 vehicle phase.
edgeSemantics.rendezvous: Physical spacecraft rendezvous, docking or assembly, with the named event supplying the time.
edgeSemantics.reference: A specifically labelled historical, programmatic or same-spacecraft relationship; not a causal assertion.
